before: Enemy bullets move downward at 250 px/s and continue independently after spawning.
after: Enemy bullets move downward at 320 px/s and continue independently after spawning.

before: While `running`, the game processes player movement and shooting, updates player bullets, moves the current enemy formation downward, advances the wave-level firing timer, spawns enemy bullets when required, and updates active enemy bullets.
after: While `running`, the game processes player movement and shooting, updates player bullets, moves the current enemy formation downward, advances the wave-level firing timer, spawns enemy bullets when required, and updates active enemy bullets at 320 px/s.
Enemy bullets move downward at 320 px/s.
